<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  const historyList = document.getElementById('notebooklm-history-list');
  if (!historyList) return;

  function updateHistory() {
    let history = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('affinedrift_notebooklm_history') || '[]');
    
    const currentPage = {
      title: document.title.replace(' - AffineDrift', '').replace('AffineDrift - ', ''),
      url: window.location.pathname.split('/').pop() || 'resources-notebooklm.html'
    };

    if (currentPage.url === 'resources-notebooklm.html') {
      history = history.filter(item => item.url !== currentPage.url);
      history.unshift(currentPage);
      history = history.slice(0, 10);
      localStorage.setItem('affinedrift_notebooklm_history', JSON.stringify(history));
    }

    if (history.length === 0) {
      historyList.innerHTML = '<li class="history-empty">No recent notebooklm yet</li>';
      return;
    }

    historyList.innerHTML = history.map(item => 
      `<li><a href="${item.url}">${item.title}</a></li>`
    ).join('');
  }

  updateHistory();
});
</script>
